The Agents SDK marked `subAgent()` as deprecated in version 0.23.0, but it still works. The release notes for subAgent() / abortSubAgent() / deleteSubAgent() / hasSubAgent() / listSubAgents() are unchanged in behavior and now delegate to the same capability — @deprecated in place, not removed.

The same release left the related pieces alone. /sub/ URLs, useAgent({ sub }), parentAgent(), and onBeforeSubAgent are untouched. The release also rewrote the sub-agents documentation, which now describes verified workerd facet semantics, including separate isolates, their own SQLite storage, and bounded nesting depth.

The results don't name a replacement API, so I can't tell you what to migrate to. The 0.23.0 note comes from a third-party mirror of GitHub release notes, so check the official release page at github.com/cloudflare/agents before relying on it. The official API reference I found still shows `this.subAgent(Researcher, "research-1")` in its example, which fits the "deprecated but present" reading.

The release notes mark the `subAgent()` family as deprecated but keep it working. `subAgent()`, `abortSubAgent()`, `deleteSubAgent()`, `hasSubAgent()`, and `listSubAgents()` are "unchanged in behavior" and now delegate to the same capability. They are marked `@deprecated` in place and have not been removed.

The replacement is the `this.dynamicAgents` facade, which exposes `get`, `abort`, `delete`, `has`, and `list`. The notes also add the type names `DynamicAgentClass` and `DynamicAgentStub`. `SubAgentClass` and `SubAgentStub` remain as compatibility aliases.

The page doesn't explicitly map each deprecated method to a facade method, though the names parallel each other.

content.text:
Not for new code. As of Agents SDK v0.23.0, `subAgent()` and the related methods (`abortSubAgent`, `deleteSubAgent`, `hasSubAgent`, `listSubAgents`) are marked `@deprecated`. They still work exactly as before because they now delegate to the new API. The replacement is the `this.dynamicAgents` facade, which has `get`, `abort`, `delete`, `has` and `list`. The release notes don't map old methods to new ones explicitly, but going by the names, `subAgent()` probably becomes `this.dynamicAgents.get()`. Existing code doesn't need an urgent rewrite, but you should plan to migrate. `/sub/` URLs, `useAgent({ sub })`, `parentAgent()` and `onBeforeSubAgent` haven't changed. The types are now named `DynamicAgentClass` and `DynamicAgentStub`, and `SubAgentClass` and `SubAgentStub` remain as aliases.

Sources:
- [cloudflare/agents release agents@0.23.0 (GitHub)](https://github.com/cloudflare/agents/releases/tag/agents@0.23.0)
- [agents@0.23.0 release mirror (newreleases.io)](https://newreleases.io/project/github/cloudflare/agents/release/agents@0.23.0)
- [Sub-agents API reference (Cloudflare docs)](https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/api-reference/sub-agents/index.md)
